review: [maya · done] Accepted. planner.py: cancel_outbox only for the suspect's own window items (queued/held/released) and released items of non-re-run actions; every other tainted queued/held item gets no step and is listed in Planned.held with its blocker (rider/replan/flag/compensate/no_creating_record); re-run items are skipped (M14 re-hold). dryrun.py: items of dropped re-runs go to DryRun.held (released ones cancelled via _refine); render prints one held line each. Matches ADR-05 §6.1 as amended. Integration-checked against B3-30 apply (tests/runtime/test_recover.py::test_bench_never_releases_rider_items_f2plus_x): F2+x plan applied through c-0, rider items stay HELD under lineage_hold, bench_releasable never lists them, verify OK. Non-blocking: a held entry may carry status queued (not yet due); it is held by the release phase's lineage_hold when due, so 'stays held' is true in effect, but the render word 'held' for a queued item could confuse a juror; consider printing 'queued (held when due)'.
